CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFLOCATION

CFLOCATION stops processing the page and answers the browser with an HTTP redirect (302 Object Moved) to the URL you give. The browser then requests that URL on its own, so the address bar shows the new page.

Category

Flow control

Syntax

<CFLOCATION URL="url"
    ADDTOKEN="Yes/No">

Attributes

URL
Required. The page to go to: a relative URL (thanks.cfm?Order=12) or an absolute one (http://www.allair.com/).
ADDTOKEN
Optional, default "Yes". When client or session management is enabled with CFAPPLICATION, Yes appends CFID and CFTOKEN to the URL so a browser without cookies keeps its session. Without client or session management nothing is added.

Usage

Nothing else on the page is sent: content generated before the tag is thrown away, and OnRequestEnd.cfm does not run. Anything you want the next page to know must travel in the URL or in the Session or Client scope.

The classic use is the post-and-redirect pattern: an action page inserts a form's data into the database, then sends the browser to a "thank you" page, so pressing Reload does not insert the row twice. Set ADDTOKEN="No" when redirecting to another site, which has no use for your session tokens.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Clicking a link redirects back to this page with a "from" parameter --->
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.Go" DEFAULT="">
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.From" DEFAULT="">
<CFIF URL.Go IS NOT "">
  <CFLOCATION URL="cflocation.cfm?From=#URLEncodedFormat(URL.Go)#" ADDTOKEN="No">
</CFIF>

<CFIF URL.From IS NOT "">
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <P><IMG SRC="/CFIDE/administrator/images/check.gif" WIDTH=16 HEIGHT=16>
  You arrived here through a <B>302 Object Moved</B> redirect.
  The link you clicked was <B>#HTMLEditFormat(URL.From)#</B>.</P>
  </CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

<P>Pick a destination. Each link calls this page with a "Go" parameter,
and CFLOCATION then sends your browser on.</P>
<UL>
  <LI><A HREF="cflocation.cfm?Go=Departure+Lounge">Departure Lounge</A>
  <LI><A HREF="cflocation.cfm?Go=Y2K+Bunker">Y2K Bunker</A>
  <LI><A HREF="cflocation.cfm">Start over (no redirect)</A>
</UL>
